transcript: Speaker A: Sir, the cement quality is not good. We should change the supplier. Speaker B: Ruk ruk ruk. Tu mazdoor hai ya engineer? Itni English kahan se aati hai? Koi course kiya hai kya? [Stop, stop, stop. Are you a laborer or an engineer? Where did you learn so much English? Did you do some course?] Speaker A: Course ke liye paisa aur time dono chahiye. Aur main toh subah 6 se raat 8 baje tak site pe rehta hoon. [For a course, you need both money and time. And I stay on site from 6 AM to 8 PM.] Speaker B: Toh phir kaise seekhi? [Then how did you learn?] Speaker A: English Seekho app se. Iska Spoken English Show ek mazdoor ko bhi farratedar English bola deta hai. Bina kisi ads ke, chhoti-chhoti videos ke through, raat ko 30 minute dekhta hoon bas. [From the English Seekho app. Its Spoken English Show makes even a laborer speak fluent English. Without any ads, through short videos, I just watch for 30 minutes at night.] Speaker B: Oh nice! Actually mujhe bhi ek site supervisor chahiye tha jo client se English mein baat kar sake. [Oh nice! Actually, I also needed a site supervisor who could talk to clients in English.] Speaker A: Bagal mein chhora aur shehar mein dhindora. Main hoon na sir. [The boy is next door but they search the whole town. I am here, sir.] Speaker B: Kal se tu supervisor hai. 35,000 mahina. [From tomorrow you are the supervisor. 35,000 a month.] Speaker A: Thank you so much, sir. Agar aap bhi apni zindagi badalna chahte ho toh English Seekho app download karo, Spoken English Show dekho. Mazdoor se supervisor tak ka safar sirf ek app door hai. [Thank you so much, sir. If you also want to change your life, download the English Seekho app, watch the Spoken English Show. The journey from laborer to supervisor is just one app away.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: जिसने English सीखी, उसकी ज़िन्दगी बदल गई। [The one who learned English, their life changed.] INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer...
summary: A construction worker impresses his manager with fluent English learned via the English Seekho app. The manager immediately promotes him to supervisor with a higher salary. The ad encourages viewers to download the app to advance their careers.
